items.reason: Took the issue's second option (offer a document type), since the svg element's rendering lives in swift-compositions/swift-svg-render (SVG.Elements.swift), which this group does not own. New Sources/SVG/SVG.Document.swift: SVG.Document(svg(...)) { ... } renders the root svg with xmlns set; plain svg { } still renders without xmlns (nested svg elements stay unchanged). If the owner prefers xmlns on every outermost svg, that is a swift-svg-render change.

api_changes: Added public struct SVG.Document<Content: SVG.View>: SVG.View (extension of SVG_Rendering's SVG enum) with init(_ root: svg, @SVG.Builder _ content:), public let root, static var namespace.
notes: Test added to Tests/SVG Tests/DocumentTests.swift. Declared as extension SVG_Rendering::SVG to avoid the module/enum name clash inside module SVG; fully qualifies SVG_Standard::SVG_Standard.Document.SVG because Document inside the extension means the new type.
